ANRC Guidelines

\n\n

\n The non-profit Autism Nutrition Research Center guidelines are designed to provide optimal nutritional support for most children and adults with autism spectrum disorders.  It includes:\n

\n
\n
    \n
  • \n Vitamins/minerals/micronutrients:  from ANRC Essentials Plus\n
    • \n
  • \n Essential Fatty Acids:  from fish oil\n
    • \n
  • \n L-carnitine:  to support mitochondria\n
    • \n
  • \n Healthy, allergen-free diet\n
    • \n \n
\n
\n\n

\n \n The ANRC protocol is based on the results of a 12-month treatment study led by Prof. Adams, which resulted in over 80% of participants reporting symptom improvements, including 7 point gain in non-verbal IQ (vs zero change in controls) and an 18-month gain in developmental age (vs 4 months for controls).  The ANRC protocol includes the top 4 of 6 treatments included in that study.\n

\n \n

\n You can also download a free copy from   AutismNRC.org. \n
